title: 名词性从句与间接问句
goal: 能按陈述语序排列间接问句，并确定 that 从句的位置和作用。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 写作

points.label: 用陈述语序排出间接问句
正确放置 that 从句

body.p: 名词性从句可以作宾语、主语或表语。that 从句陈述一件事。whether / if 从句表示是否。疑问词引出的从句表示要知道的信息。这些从句内部都用陈述语序：主语在前，谓语在后。

body.box:
The analyst said that the total was wrong.
The analyst asked whether the total was wrong.
The analyst asked why the total was wrong.

body.p: 间接问句不倒装。Where does the money go? 放在 I wonder 后面，变成 I wonder where the money goes. 去掉 does 以后，时态和单复数由 goes 表示。

cards.title: that 从句的位置
rows: 动词宾语
say、think、confirm 后面可以接 that 从句。
The analyst confirmed that the total was correct.
tell 的宾语
tell 先接听的人，再接 that 从句。
The analyst told us that the total was correct.
形容词后
certain、glad 后面可以接 that 从句。
We are certain that the total is correct.
表语从句
be 后面的 that 从句说明主语具体是什么。
The problem is that the figures do not match.
主语从句
从句放在句首作主语时，that 不能省。
That the figures differ is obvious.
形式主语
it 放在句首，真正的主语从句放在后面。
It is obvious that the figures differ.
that 与 what
that 后面是完整的句子。what 在从句里作成分，后面的句子缺一个成分。
I know that she checked it. / I know what she checked.

cards.title: whether 与 if
rows: 是否
在一般的宾语从句里，两者可以互换。
I wonder whether the estimate is final. / I wonder if the estimate is final.
陈述语序
whether 或 if 后面先接主语，再接谓语。
We asked whether the estimate included tax.
介词后
介词后面用 whether，不用 if。
The decision depends on whether funding is available.
不定式前
whether 后面可以接 to do，if 不可以。
We discussed whether to revise the estimate.
紧接 or not
可以说 whether or not，不说 if or not。
We must decide whether or not the cost is acceptable.
句首主语从句
放在句首作主语时用 whether，不用 if。
Whether the estimate includes tax is unclear.

cards.title: 间接问句语序
rows: where / when / why / how
疑问词后面接主语 + 谓语。
I wonder when the payment arrives.
which / what + 名词
疑问词和名词一起放在前面，后面用陈述语序。
We need to know which account holds the funds.
疑问词作宾语
疑问词放在前面，从句的主语仍在谓语前。
I know what the accountant checked.
be 的位置
从句里的 be 放在主语后面。
I know where the receipt is.
疑问词作主语
疑问词自己就是主语，后面直接接谓语。
I know who approved the payment.
外层疑问句
外层的问句倒装，从句内部仍用陈述语序。
Does the analyst know why the figures differ?
否定句里的 do
去掉的只是提问用的 do。否定用的 do 保留。
I know why the figures do not match.

body.box:
The invoice has an extra charge.
Do we know ______ ______ ______ ______ ?
the additional / covers / what / fee / does

body.p: 外层 Do we know 是一般疑问句，从句问的是这笔费用包括什么。what 是 covers 的宾语，放在最前面。后面先接主语 the additional fee，再接谓语 covers。does 是多出的词块。

body.box: Do we know what the additional fee covers?

body.p: the additional 和 fee 合起来是主语，放在 covers 前面。句末的问号属于外层的 Do we know，从句仍是 what the additional fee covers，不写成 what does the additional fee cover。

items.stem: The permit lists an unexplained charge.
items.why: what 后面用陈述语序 the charge is for，不倒装，也不加 does。

items.stem: The grant has several conditions.
items.why: whether 后面先接主语 the grant，再接谓语 covers，不加 does。

items.stem: The reimbursement date is missing.
items.why: 从句是 when the refund will arrive，will 放在主语后面。外层是问句，从句仍用陈述语序。

items.stem: The budget sheet does not identify its author.
items.why: who 是从句的主语，后面直接接 prepared。过去时已由 prepared 表示，不加 did。

items.stem: Was the subscription renewed?
items.why: the payment had gone through 是完整的句子，不缺成分，所以用 that，不用 what。

items.stem: Why does the ledger need updating?
items.why: is 后面的 that 从句作表语。the figures are outdated 是完整的句子，所以不用 what。

items.stem: Has the accounting error been corrected?
items.why: certain 后面接 that 从句，说明确定的是什么。the error has been corrected 不缺成分，所以不用 what。

items.stem: Did the supplier mention the discount?
items.why: told us 后面接 that 从句。applies to bulk orders 已有主语 the discount，what 多余。

items.stem: Which expenses require receipts?
items.why: states 后面接 that 从句，all travel expenses 是主语，receipts 是宾语。从句不缺成分，what 多余。

items.stem: The service agreement mentions a renewal fee.
items.why: if 表示是否，后面接 the renewal fee includes maintenance，不加 does。

items.stem: Is the deposit refundable?
items.why: It 是形式主语，真正的主语是 that the deposit is refundable。从句不缺成分，所以不用 what。

items.stem: Can the project continue?
items.why: 介词 on 后面表示是否，用 whether，不用 if。

items.stem: The insurance form does not explain the exemption.
items.why: why 后面是 this purchase is exempt，is 放在主语后面，不加 does。

items.stem: The royalty statement has two totals.
items.why: which total 是 used 的宾语，后面接 the publisher used。从句用陈述语序，不加 did。

items.stem: The donation agreement has not been signed.
items.why: whether 后面是陈述语序 the donor accepts the terms，不加 does。

items.stem: The application does not mention postage.
items.why: if 表示是否，后面先接主语 the application fee，再接谓语 includes，不加 does。

items.stem: The currency exchange receipt is unclear.
items.why: what 是 charged 的宾语，the cashier 是从句的主语。外层的 Do 已经构成问句，从句不再倒装。

items.stem: Was the patent renewal processed?
items.why: said 后面接 that 从句，the renewal 是主语，had been processed 是谓语。从句不缺成分，what 多余。

items.stem: Why was the catering order revised?
items.why: The reason is 后面接 that 引出的表语从句。the guest list has changed 不缺成分，所以不用 what。

items.stem: Has the auction reserve been confirmed?
items.why: told me 后面接 that 从句，the reserve price was unchanged 是完整的句子，what 多余。

items.stem: Are the scholarship funds available?
items.why: pleased 后面接 that 从句，说明高兴的原因。the funds have been released 是完整的句子，what 多余。

items.stem: Are the exhibition fees different this year?
items.why: It 是形式主语，真正的主语是 that the fees have increased。从句不缺成分，所以不用 what。
